name: Sherlock
text: The bazaar opened with ten stalls and no departures; the graveyard remains empty and the roster untouched since dawn. Nothing in the night’s public facts demands a ledger beyond that silence. I ask Yoda: which merchant on the roster has not yet stated a plain fact about today’s conditions?

name: Sherlock
text: I ask Batman: you told the bazaar that the Detective “acts before the vote,” yet our Compact says power roles act only after the vote. Which public fact in the Compact, the Herald, or today’s statements shows the Detective acting before the vote?

name: Sherlock
text: I ask Morpheus a plain question: your statement says the roster lists every merchant’s voice, yet you did not name one merchant who remains silent today—Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda, Batman, Ripley, Neo, Elsa, Morpheus, Inigo, and Sherlock have each spoken. Which name on that list have you left unmentioned?
